question.text: The maximum number of points on the parabola <math><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>16</mn><mi>x</mi></math> which are equidistant from a variable point <math><mi>P</mi><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi></math> (which lie inside the parabola) are

solution.text:
The maximum number of points on the parabola will be obtained when they are intersection point with a circle.
A circle can intersect a parabola at maximum 4 points
